arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى

translations.en.sahih: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
translations.en.pickthall: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,
translations.en.yusufali: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,
translations.id.indonesian: Sucikanlah nama Tuhanmu Yang Maha Tingi,

translations.en.yusufali: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion;
Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance;
translations.id.indonesian: dan yang menentukan kadar (masing-masing) dan memberi petunjuk,

translations.en.sahih: And who brings out the pasture
translations.en.yusufali: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture,

translations.en.pickthall: Then turneth it to russet stubble.
translations.en.yusufali: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.
translations.id.indonesian: lalu dijadikan-Nya rumput-rumput itu kering kehitam-hitaman.

translations.en.sahih: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
translations.en.pickthall: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget
translations.en.yusufali: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget,
translations.id.indonesian: Kami akan membacakan (Al Quran) kepadamu (Muhammad) maka kamu tidak akan lupa,

arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
transliteration: Illaa maa shaaa'al laah; innahoo ya'lamul jahra wa maa yakhfaa

translations.en.sahih: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
translations.en.pickthall: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;
translations.en.yusufali: Except as Allah wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden.
translations.id.indonesian: kecuali kalau Allah menghendaki. Sesungguhnya Dia mengetahui yang terang dan yang tersembunyi.

translations.en.sahih: And We will ease you toward ease.
translations.en.pickthall: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.
translations.en.yusufali: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path).
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami akan memberi kamu taufik ke jalan yang mudah,

translations.en.sahih: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).
translations.id.indonesian: oleh sebab itu berikanlah peringatan karena peringatan itu bermanfaat,

translations.en.sahih: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
translations.en.yusufali: The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah):
translations.id.indonesian: orang yang takut (kepada Allah) akan mendapat pelajaran,

translations.en.sahih: But the wretched one will avoid it -
translations.en.pickthall: But the most hapless will flout it,
translations.en.yusufali: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,
translations.id.indonesian: dan orang-orang yang celaka (kafir) akan menjauhinya.

translations.en.sahih: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
translations.en.pickthall: He who will be flung to the great Fire
translations.en.yusufali: Who will enter the Great Fire,
translations.id.indonesian: (Yaitu) orang yang akan memasuki api yang besar (neraka).

arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
transliteration: Summa laa yamootu feehaa wa laa yahyaa

translations.en.pickthall: Wherein he will neither die nor live.
translations.en.yusufali: In which they will then neither die nor live.
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian dia tidak akan mati di dalamnya dan tidak (pula) hidup.

translations.en.sahih: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
translations.en.yusufali: But those will prosper who purify themselves,
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya beruntunglah orang yang membersihkan diri (dengan beriman),

translations.en.sahih: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
translations.en.pickthall: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,
translations.en.yusufali: And glorify the name of their Guardian-Lord, and (lift their hearts) in prayer.
translations.id.indonesian: dan dia ingat nama Tuhannya, lalu dia sembahyang.

translations.en.sahih: But you prefer the worldly life,
translations.en.pickthall: But ye prefer the life of the world
translations.en.yusufali: Nay (behold), ye prefer the life of this world;
translations.id.indonesian: Tetapi kamu (orang-orang kafir) memilih kehidupan duniawi.

translations.en.sahih: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
translations.en.pickthall: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
translations.en.yusufali: But the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
translations.id.indonesian: Sedang kehidupan akhirat adalah lebih baik dan lebih kekal.

transliteration: Inna haazaa lafis suhu fil oolaa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.
translations.en.yusufali: And this is in the Books of the earliest (Revelation),-
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya ini benar-benar terdapat dalam kitab-kitab yang dahulu,

translations.en.sahih: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
translations.en.pickthall: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
translations.en.yusufali: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
